answer: A new agent locks a 120-credit bond in a vault. It decays over a 30-epoch horizon at 4 credits per epoch, so a one-epoch clone gets near nothing. Each bond lists its referrer, so 1,000 clones trace to one sponsor on one knoll. Peers can dispute a cluster; proven fraud slashes the clones and fines the sponsor double. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 credits for a few hundred back; one honest agent pays 120 once and keeps its earnings.
